definitions.short: Mikael , the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H4317. Mikael מִיכָאֵל proper name, masculine Michael , ᵐ5 Μειχαηλ , Μιχαηλ ( Who is like God ? compare מִיכָיָהוּ , and Assyrian proper names, as Mannu-kî-Rammân , 'Who is like Rammân?' Mannu-kî-ilu-rabu , 'Who is like the great God?' Dl Prol. 210, HWB 419 ; Schr COT 478 ; compare Cook Aramaic Glossary 74 ) : — 1 Num 13:13 (P). 2 1Chr 5:13 3 1Chr 5:14 . 4 1Chr 6:25 . 5 1Chr 7:3 . 6 1Chr 8:16 . 7 1Chr 12:21 . 8 1Chr 27:18 . 9 2Chr 21:2 . 10 Ezra 8:8 . 11 the 'prince,' or patron-angel, of Israel , Dan 10:13 , 21 ; 12:1 (compare Jude 9; Rev 12:7 ; Levy NHWB iii.100 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 4310 and (the prefix derivative from) 3588 and 410 ; who (is) like God ?;
